name: Ara
overview: Ara is a male figure from the tribe of Asher, known specifically as the son of Jether (also called Ithran). Beyond this genealogical detail, Scripture provides no additional notes about his life or actions. His mention is brief and primarily genealogical within the biblical record.
namesAndTitles: The name 'Ara' appears as a proper name in Scripture without a given meaning or divine origin. It is simply recorded as the personal name of this individual without further explanation.
familyAndRelationships: Ara is explicitly identified as the son of Ithran (also named Jether) according to 1 Chronicles 7:38. Scripture does not provide further information about his family or other relationships beyond this father-son connection.
scriptureSignificance: Ara's significance lies chiefly in his place within the genealogical records of the tribe of Asher. As the son of Jether (Ithran), his mention helps preserve the lineage and tribal heritage important to Israel's history. Although his role is not elaborated upon, such genealogies affirm God's providential care in preserving His covenant people through successive generations.
